module

public import KimiK3.Common
public import KimiK3.Sequence.Scan
public import KimiK3.Config
public import NN.Spec.Layers.Activation
public import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Sigmoid

/-!
# Kimi Delta Attention

`update` decays the recurrent matrix and writes a key-aligned value correction. `Layer` adds
the learned projections, newest-first short-convolution windows, normalization, and output
gating. Sequence and streaming functions share this token transition, and their scan laws
compare runs with the same operations and inputs.

Reference: Kimi K3 technical report, Sections 2.1--2.2, pp. 4--6, Eqs. 1--10.
https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24653.
-/

@[expose] public section

namespace KimiK3

open Spec TorchLean
open Tensor

/-- Parameters of one causal depthwise short convolution. -/
structure ShortConv (α : Type) [Storage α] (width channels : Nat) where
  /-- One scalar coefficient for each tap and channel. -/
  weight : Tensor α [width, channels]
  /-- Per-channel bias. -/
  bias : Tensor α [channels]

namespace ShortConv

variable {α : Type} [Storage α] [Context α]
variable {width channels : Nat}

/--
Apply a short convolution to a newest-first projected-token history.  Missing old tokens are zero
padded, so the definition is causal for every history length.
-/
def forward (conv : ShortConv α width channels)
    (history : List (Tensor α [channels])) : Tensor α [channels] :=
  let zero : Tensor α [channels] := Tensor.zeros [channels]
  Tensor.stackLeading (fun channel => Tensor.scalar <|
    (List.finRange width).foldl (fun total tap =>
      total + Tensor.getScalar (history.getD tap.val zero) channel * get2 conv.weight tap channel)
      (Tensor.getScalar conv.bias channel))

/-- A short convolution never reads beyond its window. Truncating the history keeps the addition
order and every scalar operation, so this holds in rounded scalar contexts too. -/
theorem forward_take (conv : ShortConv α width channels)
    (history : List (Tensor α [channels])) :
    conv.forward (history.take width) = conv.forward history := by
  unfold forward
  apply congrArg Tensor.stackLeading
  funext channel
  apply congrArg Tensor.scalar
  apply List.foldl_ext
  intro total tap _
  simp only [List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, List.getElem?_take_of_lt tap.isLt]

/-- Apply the causal convolution to a full newest-first window.

The leading axis is the tap axis: row zero is the current projected token and later rows are
successively older tokens. Streaming code keeps this fixed-size window, while the list-based
`forward` serves the zero-padded causal specification. Here the bias is added after the tap sum
(`forward` starts its fold from the bias), so rounded results need not agree with `forward`.
-/
def forwardWindow (conv : ShortConv α width channels) (hWidth : 0 < width)
    (window : Tensor α [width, channels]) :
    Tensor α [channels] :=
  Tensor.addSpec
    (Tensor.reduceSum 0 (Tensor.mulSpec window conv.weight)
      (Shape.hasNonemptyAxisZeroOfPos hWidth).proof) conv.bias

end ShortConv

/-- Input to the mathematical single-head KDA recurrence in Eq. 1. -/
structure KDA.Input (α : Type) [Storage α] (keyDim valueDim : Nat) where
  /-- Query used to read the updated recurrent matrix. -/
  query : Tensor α [keyDim]
  /-- Unit-regularized key used by the delta update. -/
  key : Tensor α [keyDim]
  /-- Value written into the recurrent matrix. -/
  value : Tensor α [valueDim]
  /-- Coordinate-wise multiplicative retention. -/
  retention : Tensor α [keyDim]
  /-- Scalar delta-rule write gate. -/
  writeStrength : α

namespace KDA

variable {α : Type} [Storage α] [Context α]
variable {keyDim valueDim : Nat}

/-- Recurrent KDA state `S ∈ R^(d_k × d_v)`. -/
abbrev State (α : Type) [Storage α] (keyDim valueDim : Nat) :=
  Tensor α [keyDim, valueDim]

/--
One single-head KDA recurrence (Eq. 1):

`S_t = (I - β_t k_t k_tᵀ) Diag(α_t) S_(t-1) + β_t k_t v_tᵀ`.

It is implemented in the factorized form of an efficient kernel: decay the rows of the state,
read the decayed state with the key, subtract the key-aligned correction, then add the rank-one
write.
-/
def update (state : State α keyDim valueDim) (input : KDA.Input α keyDim valueDim) :
    State α keyDim valueDim :=
  let decayed := Tensor.stackLeading fun row => Tensor.stackLeading fun column => Tensor.scalar <|
    Tensor.getScalar input.retention row * get2 state row column
  let correction := vecMatMulSpec input.key decayed
  Tensor.addSpec
    (Tensor.subSpec decayed
      (Tensor.mulSpec
        (Tensor.full [keyDim, valueDim] input.writeStrength)
        (outerProductSpec input.key correction)))
    (Tensor.mulSpec
      (Tensor.full [keyDim, valueDim] input.writeStrength)
      (outerProductSpec input.key input.value))

/-- Coordinate form of the factorized KDA update.

Its correction coordinate reads the key from the already decayed state, so decay comes before the
delta correction.
-/
theorem update_get2 (state : State ℝ keyDim valueDim)
    (input : KDA.Input ℝ keyDim valueDim) (row : Fin keyDim) (column : Fin valueDim) :
  let decayed := Tensor.stackLeading fun source => Tensor.stackLeading fun target => Tensor.scalar
    (Tensor.getScalar input.retention source * get2 state source target)
  get2 (update state input) row column =
      Tensor.getScalar input.retention row * get2 state row column -
        input.writeStrength * Tensor.getScalar input.key row *
          Tensor.getScalar (vecMatMulSpec input.key decayed) column +
        input.writeStrength * Tensor.getScalar input.key row *
          Tensor.getScalar input.value column := by
  simp [update, Tensor.stackLeading, Tensor.addSpec, Tensor.subSpec, Tensor.mulSpec]
  ring

/-- Read the current output after the state update: `o_t = S_tᵀ q_t`. -/
def read (state : State α keyDim valueDim) (query : Tensor α [keyDim]) :
    Tensor α [valueDim] :=
  vecMatMulSpec query state

/-- One recurrence step returns the updated state and its current-token output. -/
def step (state : State α keyDim valueDim) (input : KDA.Input α keyDim valueDim) :
    State α keyDim valueDim × Tensor α [valueDim] :=
  let next := update state input
  (next, read next input.query)

/-- Sequential semantics for a projected KDA sequence. -/
def run (state : State α keyDim valueDim) (inputs : List (KDA.Input α keyDim valueDim)) :=
  CausalScan.run step state inputs

/-- A single-head KDA scan emits one value vector per projected token. -/
theorem run_outputs_length (state : State α keyDim valueDim)
    (inputs : List (KDA.Input α keyDim valueDim)) :
    (run state inputs).2.length = inputs.length := by
  exact CausalScan.outputs_length step state inputs

/-- Chunk boundaries do not change the KDA recurrence or emitted outputs. -/
theorem run_append (state : State α keyDim valueDim)
    (left right : List (KDA.Input α keyDim valueDim)) :
    run state (left ++ right) =
      let first := run state left
      let second := run first.1 right
      (second.1, first.2 ++ second.2) :=
  CausalScan.run_append step state left right

/-- Lower-bounded real retention from Eq. 5. -/
noncomputable def retentionReal (logFloor logScale logit : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Real.exp (logFloor * Real.sigmoid (Real.exp logScale * logit))

/--
K3's retention parameterization lies strictly between `exp(logFloor)` and one, so no channel's
retention can approach zero.
-/
theorem retentionReal_bounds {logFloor : ℝ} (hFloor : logFloor < 0) (logScale logit : ℝ) :
    Real.exp logFloor < retentionReal logFloor logScale logit ∧
      retentionReal logFloor logScale logit < 1 := by
  have hSigPos : 0 < Real.sigmoid (Real.exp logScale * logit) := Real.sigmoid_pos _
  have hSigLt : Real.sigmoid (Real.exp logScale * logit) < 1 := Real.sigmoid_lt_one _
  have hLower : logFloor < logFloor * Real.sigmoid (Real.exp logScale * logit) := by
    nlinarith
  have hUpper : logFloor * Real.sigmoid (Real.exp logScale * logit) < 0 := by
    exact mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos hFloor hSigPos
  constructor
  · exact Real.exp_lt_exp.mpr hLower
  · simpa [retentionReal] using Real.exp_lt_one_iff.mpr hUpper

/-- With the paper's floor `logFloor = -5`, every one-step retention lies strictly between
`exp(-5)` and `1`. -/
theorem paper_retention_bounds (logScale logit : ℝ) :
    Real.exp (-5) < retentionReal (-5) logScale logit ∧
      retentionReal (-5) logScale logit < 1 := by
  exact retentionReal_bounds (by norm_num) logScale logit

end KDA

/-- Projection and gating parameters for one KDA head. -/
structure KDA.Head (α : Type) [Storage α] (modelDim keyDim valueDim convWidth decayRank : Nat) where
  /-- Model-to-query projection. -/
  queryWeight : Tensor α [modelDim, keyDim]
  /-- Model-to-key projection. -/
  keyWeight : Tensor α [modelDim, keyDim]
  /-- Model-to-value projection. -/
  valueWeight : Tensor α [modelDim, valueDim]
  /-- Depthwise causal convolution for projected queries. -/
  queryConv : ShortConv α convWidth keyDim
  /-- Depthwise causal convolution for projected keys. -/
  keyConv : ShortConv α convWidth keyDim
  /-- Depthwise causal convolution for projected values. -/
  valueConv : ShortConv α convWidth valueDim
  /-- Projection producing the scalar delta-rule write gate. -/
  betaWeight : Tensor α [modelDim]
  /-- First factor of the low-rank retention projection. -/
  decayDown : Tensor α [modelDim, decayRank]
  /-- Second factor of the low-rank retention projection. -/
  decayUp : Tensor α [decayRank, keyDim]
  /-- Coordinate-wise retention bias. -/
  decayBias : Tensor α [keyDim]
  /-- Learned logarithm of the retention-logit scale. -/
  decayLogScale : α

namespace KDA.Head

variable {α : Type} [Storage α] [Context α]
variable {modelDim keyDim valueDim convWidth decayRank : Nat}

/-- Build the recurrence input from the three short-convolution outputs: swish activations, L2
normalization of query and key, and the retention and write gates of the current token. -/
def activate (head : KDA.Head α modelDim keyDim valueDim convWidth decayRank)
    (logFloor : α) (current : Tensor α [modelDim])
    (qPre kPre : Tensor α [keyDim]) (vPre : Tensor α [valueDim]) :
    KDA.Input α keyDim valueDim :=
  let query := Spec.normalizeL2RegularizedSpec (Tensor.map Activation.Math.swishSpec qPre)
    Normalize.l2Epsilon
  let key := Spec.normalizeL2RegularizedSpec (Tensor.map Activation.Math.swishSpec kPre)
    Normalize.l2Epsilon
  let value := Tensor.map Activation.Math.swishSpec vPre
  let decayLogit :=
    Tensor.addSpec (vecMatMulSpec (vecMatMulSpec current head.decayDown) head.decayUp)
      head.decayBias
  let scale := MathFunctions.exp head.decayLogScale
  let retention := Tensor.map
    (fun z => MathFunctions.exp (logFloor * Activation.Math.sigmoidSpec (scale * z))) decayLogit
  let beta := Activation.Math.sigmoidSpec (Tensor.dotSpec current head.betaWeight)
  { query, key, value, retention, writeStrength := beta }

/-- Prepare one recurrence step, projecting only the tokens read by the convolution window. -/
def prepare (head : KDA.Head α modelDim keyDim valueDim convWidth decayRank)
    (logFloor : α) (current : Tensor α [modelDim])
    (history : List (Tensor α [modelDim])) : KDA.Input α keyDim valueDim :=
  let window := (current :: history).take convWidth
  head.activate logFloor current
    (head.queryConv.forward (window.map (vecMatMulSpec · head.queryWeight)))
    (head.keyConv.forward (window.map (vecMatMulSpec · head.keyWeight)))
    (head.valueConv.forward (window.map (vecMatMulSpec · head.valueWeight)))

/-- Projecting only the convolution window agrees with projecting the complete history, with no
associativity or real-arithmetic assumption. -/
theorem prepare_eq_full_history (head : KDA.Head α modelDim keyDim valueDim convWidth decayRank)
    (logFloor : α) (current : Tensor α [modelDim])
    (history : List (Tensor α [modelDim])) :
    head.prepare logFloor current history = head.activate logFloor current
      (head.queryConv.forward ((current :: history).map (vecMatMulSpec · head.queryWeight)))
      (head.keyConv.forward ((current :: history).map (vecMatMulSpec · head.keyWeight)))
      (head.valueConv.forward ((current :: history).map (vecMatMulSpec · head.valueWeight))) := by
  simp [prepare, List.map_take, ShortConv.forward_take]

/-- Construct one head's recurrence input from a fixed newest-first model-width window.

This is the tensor ABI of the executable graph. One matrix multiplication projects the whole
window before the three depthwise convolutions. L2 normalization uses the `10⁻⁶` stabilizer of
the released FlashKDA reference and CUDA kernel.
-/
def prepareWindow (head : KDA.Head α modelDim keyDim valueDim convWidth decayRank)
    (hWidth : 0 < convWidth) (logFloor : α)
    (window : Tensor α [convWidth, modelDim]) :
    KDA.Input α keyDim valueDim :=
  let current := Spec.get window ⟨0, hWidth⟩
  let qPre := head.queryConv.forwardWindow hWidth (matMulSpec window head.queryWeight)
  let kPre := head.keyConv.forwardWindow hWidth (matMulSpec window head.keyWeight)
  let vPre := head.valueConv.forwardWindow hWidth (matMulSpec window head.valueWeight)
  head.activate logFloor current qPre kPre vPre

end KDA.Head

/-- Complete multi-head KDA layer with a full-rank output gate (Eq. 6). -/
structure KDA.Layer (α : Type) [Storage α]
    (modelDim heads keyDim valueDim convWidth decayRank : Nat) where
  /-- Parameters indexed by attention head. -/
  head : Fin heads → KDA.Head α modelDim keyDim valueDim convWidth decayRank
  /-- Full-rank output-gate projection. -/
  gateWeight : Tensor α [modelDim, heads, valueDim]
  /-- Per-head projection back to model width. -/
  outputWeight : Tensor α [heads, valueDim, modelDim]
  /-- Per-head RMSNorm scale applied before output gating. -/
  outputNormScale : Tensor α [heads, valueDim]

namespace KDA.Layer

variable {α : Type} [Storage α] [Context α]
variable {modelDim heads keyDim valueDim convWidth decayRank : Nat}

/-- State carried by every KDA head.

Heads run along the leading tensor axis.  A packed tensor, rather than a function
`Fin heads → KDA.State`, makes the specification state the same value that GraphSpec and the
runtime pass around.  `Spec.get state head` still gives one head's matrix.
-/
abbrev State (α : Type) [Storage α] (heads keyDim valueDim : Nat) :=
  Tensor α [heads, keyDim, valueDim]

/-- Full-rank output gates, arranged as one row per attention head.

In the published layout the gate weight has shape `(modelDim, heads, valueDim)`, so each head
multiplies the hidden vector by its own `(modelDim, valueDim)` slice and applies a sigmoid.  Its
packed result has the same layout as the GraphSpec graph.
-/
def gates (layer : KDA.Layer α modelDim heads keyDim valueDim convWidth decayRank)
    (x : Tensor α [modelDim]) :
    Tensor α [heads, valueDim] :=
  Tensor.stackLeading fun head =>
    Tensor.map Activation.Math.sigmoidSpec <|
      vecMatMulSpec x <| Tensor.stackLeading fun input =>
        Spec.get (Spec.get layer.gateWeight input) head

/-- Read every recurrent head, normalize it, apply its output gate, and project back to model
width.

It takes the already updated state and no projection or convolution parameters, so
GraphSpec reuses it as the target of the post-update subgraph.
-/
def readout (state : Tensor α [heads, keyDim, valueDim])
    (query : Tensor α [heads, keyDim])
    (gate : Tensor α [heads, valueDim])
    (outputWeight : Tensor α [heads, valueDim, modelDim])
    (outputNormScale : Tensor α [heads, valueDim]) :
    Tensor α [modelDim] :=
  let headOutput := Tensor.stackLeading fun h =>
    RMSNorm.scale (KDA.read (Spec.get state h) (Spec.get query h))
      (Spec.get outputNormScale h)
  let gated := mulSpec gate headOutput
  let projectedHeads := Tensor.stackLeading fun h =>
    vecMatMulSpec (Spec.get gated h) (Spec.get outputWeight h)
  Tensor.stackLeading fun output => Tensor.scalar <|
    (List.finRange heads).foldl (fun total head =>
      total + Tensor.getScalar (Spec.get projectedHeads head) output) 0

/-- Complete one layer step after every head's recurrence inputs have been prepared.

`step` and `stepWindow` both call it, so the list-based causal specification and the
fixed-window graph target share one copy of the recurrence, output normalization, full-rank gate,
and output projection.
-/
def stepPrepared (layer : KDA.Layer α modelDim heads keyDim valueDim convWidth decayRank)
    (state : State α heads keyDim valueDim) (x : Tensor α [modelDim])
    (prepared : Fin heads → KDA.Input α keyDim valueDim) :
    State α heads keyDim valueDim × Tensor α [modelDim] :=
  let next := Tensor.stackLeading fun h => KDA.update (Spec.get state h) (prepared h)
  let query := Tensor.stackLeading fun h => (prepared h).query
  (next, readout next query (layer.gates x) layer.outputWeight layer.outputNormScale)

/-- One token step through every KDA head and the shared output projection. -/
def step (layer : KDA.Layer α modelDim heads keyDim valueDim convWidth decayRank)
    (logFloor : α) (history : List (Tensor α [modelDim]))
    (state : State α heads keyDim valueDim) (x : Tensor α [modelDim]) :
    State α heads keyDim valueDim × Tensor α [modelDim] :=
  layer.stepPrepared state x fun head => (layer.head head).prepare logFloor x history

/-- One complete KDA layer step from a fixed newest-first model-width window. -/
def stepWindow (layer : KDA.Layer α modelDim heads keyDim valueDim convWidth decayRank)
    (hWidth : 0 < convWidth) (logFloor : α)
    (window : Tensor α [convWidth, modelDim])
    (state : State α heads keyDim valueDim) :
    State α heads keyDim valueDim × Tensor α [modelDim] :=
  let current := Spec.get window ⟨0, hWidth⟩
  layer.stepPrepared state current fun head =>
    (layer.head head).prepareWindow hWidth logFloor window

/-- Appending one row to a positive-width window prefix restores the original width. -/
theorem rollWindow_shape_eq (hWidth : 0 < convWidth) :
    ([1 + (convWidth - 1), modelDim] : Shape) =
      [convWidth, modelDim] := by
  congr 1
  omega

/-- Uncast tensor operation underlying `rollWindow`. -/
def rollWindowRaw (current : Tensor α [modelDim])
    (previous : Tensor α [convWidth, modelDim]) :
    Tensor α [1 + (convWidth - 1), modelDim] :=
  let currentRow : Tensor α [1, modelDim] :=
    Tensor.reshapeSpec current (by simp [Shape.size])
  let retained := Tensor.sliceAxisRangeSpec 0 previous 0 (convWidth - 1) (by simp)
  Tensor.concat currentRow retained

/-- Advance the fixed newest-first short-convolution window by one token.

The current token becomes row zero, the previous first `convWidth - 1` rows move back by one
position, and the oldest row is discarded.  This is the transition the executable graph refines.
-/
def rollWindow (hWidth : 0 < convWidth)
    (current : Tensor α [modelDim])
    (previous : Tensor α [convWidth, modelDim]) :
    Tensor α [convWidth, modelDim] :=
  KDA.Layer.rollWindow_shape_eq hWidth ▸ KDA.Layer.rollWindowRaw current previous

/-- Streaming KDA state: recurrent head matrices together with newest-first token history for the
causal short convolutions. -/
abbrev ScanState (α : Type) [Storage α] (modelDim heads keyDim valueDim : Nat) :=
  State α heads keyDim valueDim × List (Tensor α [modelDim])

/-- One streaming layer step, including the short-convolution history update. -/
def scanStep (layer : KDA.Layer α modelDim heads keyDim valueDim convWidth decayRank)
    (logFloor : α) (state : ScanState α modelDim heads keyDim valueDim)
    (x : Tensor α [modelDim]) :
    ScanState α modelDim heads keyDim valueDim × Tensor α [modelDim] :=
  let result := layer.step logFloor state.2 state.1 x
  ((result.1, x :: state.2), result.2)

/-- A streaming KDA step puts the current token at the front of the convolution history. -/
theorem scanStep_history
    (layer : KDA.Layer α modelDim heads keyDim valueDim convWidth decayRank)
    (logFloor : α) (state : ScanState α modelDim heads keyDim valueDim)
    (x : Tensor α [modelDim]) :
    (layer.scanStep logFloor state x).1.2 = x :: state.2 := by
  rfl

/-- Run a KDA layer from a given streaming state. -/
def run (layer : KDA.Layer α modelDim heads keyDim valueDim convWidth decayRank)
    (logFloor : α) (state : ScanState α modelDim heads keyDim valueDim)
    (tokens : List (Tensor α [modelDim])) :=
  CausalScan.run (layer.scanStep logFloor) state tokens

/-- A multi-head KDA scan emits one model-width vector per token. -/
theorem run_outputs_length
    (layer : KDA.Layer α modelDim heads keyDim valueDim convWidth decayRank)
    (logFloor : α) (state : ScanState α modelDim heads keyDim valueDim)
    (tokens : List (Tensor α [modelDim])) :
    (layer.run logFloor state tokens).2.length = tokens.length := by
  exact CausalScan.outputs_length (layer.scanStep logFloor) state tokens

/-- Chunked KDA execution preserves the recurrent matrices, convolution history, and outputs. -/
theorem run_append
    (layer : KDA.Layer α modelDim heads keyDim valueDim convWidth decayRank)
    (logFloor : α) (state : ScanState α modelDim heads keyDim valueDim)
    (left right : List (Tensor α [modelDim])) :
    layer.run logFloor state (left ++ right) =
      let first := layer.run logFloor state left
      let second := layer.run logFloor first.1 right
      (second.1, first.2 ++ second.2) :=
  CausalScan.run_append (layer.scanStep logFloor) state left right

end KDA.Layer

end KimiK3

module

public import KimiK3.Common
public import KimiK3.Sequence.Scan
public import NN.Spec.Layers.Activation

/-!
# Gated Multi-head Latent Attention

Each cache entry stores a compressed key/value vector and an unrotated shared key. Heads
reconstruct their keys and values from those entries. The current token is appended before
attention. `step` uses a growing list cache for the causal proofs, and `stepFixed` uses packed
tensors for the fixed-context graph. Each is proved against its own consumer, and no theorem
relates the two caches.

Reference: Kimi K3 technical report, Sections 2.1--2.2, pp. 4--6, Eqs. 1--10.
https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24653.
-/

@[expose] public section

namespace KimiK3

open Spec TorchLean
open Tensor

/-- One cached MLA token: a normalized KV latent and a shared, unrotated key component. -/
structure GatedMLA.Entry (α : Type) [Storage α] (kvLatentDim sharedKeyDim : Nat) where
  /-- Shared normalized KV latent from which every head reconstructs keys and values. -/
  latent : Tensor α [kvLatentDim]
  /-- Shared unrotated key coordinates retained for attention scoring. -/
  sharedKey : Tensor α [sharedKeyDim]

/-- Gated MLA parameters.  K3 uses NoPE attention, so there are no positional-encoding weights. -/
structure GatedMLA (α : Type) [Storage α]
    (modelDim heads queryLatentDim kvLatentDim contentKeyDim sharedKeyDim valueDim : Nat) where
  /-- Low-rank query projection. -/
  queryDown : Tensor α [modelDim, queryLatentDim]
  /-- RMSNorm scale for the compressed query. -/
  queryNormScale : Tensor α [queryLatentDim]
  /-- Shared compressed key/value projection. -/
  kvDown : Tensor α [modelDim, kvLatentDim]
  /-- RMSNorm scale for the compressed key/value latent. -/
  kvNormScale : Tensor α [kvLatentDim]
  /-- Projection producing the unrotated shared key. -/
  sharedKeyDown : Tensor α [modelDim, sharedKeyDim]
  /-- Content-query up-projection, with one matrix per head. -/
  queryContentUp : Tensor α [heads, queryLatentDim, contentKeyDim]
  /-- Shared-query up-projection, with one matrix per head. -/
  querySharedUp : Tensor α [heads, queryLatentDim, sharedKeyDim]
  /-- Content-key up-projection, with one matrix per head. -/
  keyUp : Tensor α [heads, kvLatentDim, contentKeyDim]
  /-- Value up-projection, with one matrix per head. -/
  valueUp : Tensor α [heads, kvLatentDim, valueDim]
  /-- Full-rank per-head output gate. -/
  gateWeight : Tensor α [modelDim, heads, valueDim]
  /-- Per-head value projection back to model width. -/
  outputWeight : Tensor α [heads, valueDim, modelDim]

namespace GatedMLA

variable {α : Type} [Storage α] [Context α]
variable {modelDim heads queryLatentDim kvLatentDim contentKeyDim sharedKeyDim valueDim : Nat}

/-- A list of cache entries, each holding the two shared representations every head is
reconstructed from. -/
abbrev Cache (α : Type) [Storage α] (kvLatentDim sharedKeyDim : Nat) :=
  List (Entry α kvLatentDim sharedKeyDim)

/-- Normalized global attention for one head over its compressed cache. -/
def attend
    (layer :
      GatedMLA α modelDim heads queryLatentDim kvLatentDim contentKeyDim sharedKeyDim valueDim)
    (head : Fin heads)
    (queryLatent : Tensor α [queryLatentDim])
    (cache : Cache α kvLatentDim sharedKeyDim) : Tensor α [valueDim] :=
  let queryContent := vecMatMulSpec queryLatent (Spec.get layer.queryContentUp head)
  let queryShared := vecMatMulSpec queryLatent (Spec.get layer.querySharedUp head)
  let score := fun entry =>
    MathFunctions.exp ((Tensor.dotSpec queryContent
      (vecMatMulSpec entry.latent (Spec.get layer.keyUp head)) +
      Tensor.dotSpec queryShared entry.sharedKey) /
      MathFunctions.sqrt (contentKeyDim + sharedKeyDim : α))
  let denominator := cache.foldl (fun total entry => total + score entry) 0
  cache.foldl (fun output entry =>
    let weight := score entry / denominator
    output + Tensor.map (fun value => weight * value)
      (vecMatMulSpec entry.latent (Spec.get layer.valueUp head)))
    (Tensor.zeros [valueDim])

/-- One complete Gated MLA step at a fixed context length.

Here the caches are rank-two tensors and all heads run in one batched calculation, which is the form
the typed executable graph is proved against.  Returns both caches with the current token
appended, together with the projected model output.
-/
def stepFixed (pastTokens : Nat)
    (layer :
      GatedMLA α modelDim heads queryLatentDim kvLatentDim contentKeyDim sharedKeyDim valueDim)
    (pastLatentCache : Tensor α [pastTokens, kvLatentDim])
    (pastSharedKeyCache : Tensor α [pastTokens, sharedKeyDim])
    (x : Tensor α [modelDim]) (scoreScale : α) :
    Tensor α [pastTokens + 1, kvLatentDim] ×
      Tensor α [pastTokens + 1, sharedKeyDim] ×
      Tensor α [modelDim] :=
  let queryProjected := vecMatMulSpec x layer.queryDown
  let queryLatent := RMSNorm.scale queryProjected layer.queryNormScale
  let kvProjected := vecMatMulSpec x layer.kvDown
  let currentKV := RMSNorm.scale kvProjected layer.kvNormScale
  let currentShared := vecMatMulSpec x layer.sharedKeyDown
  let currentKVRow : Tensor α [1, kvLatentDim] :=
    Tensor.reshapeSpec currentKV (by simp [Shape.size])
  let currentSharedRow : Tensor α [1, sharedKeyDim] :=
    Tensor.reshapeSpec currentShared (by simp [Shape.size])
  let latentCache := Tensor.concat pastLatentCache currentKVRow
  let sharedKeyCache := Tensor.concat pastSharedKeyCache currentSharedRow
  let queryBatchSource : Tensor α [1, 1, queryLatentDim] :=
    Tensor.reshapeSpec queryLatent (by simp [Shape.size])
  let queryBatch : Tensor α [heads, 1, queryLatentDim] :=
    Tensor.broadcastTo
      (Shape.CanBroadcastTo.dim_1_to_n
        (Shape.CanBroadcastTo.dim_eq
          (Shape.CanBroadcastTo.dim_eq
            (Shape.CanBroadcastTo.scalarTo [])))) queryBatchSource
  let latentBatchSource :
      Tensor α [1, pastTokens + 1, kvLatentDim] :=
    Tensor.reshapeSpec latentCache (by simp [Shape.size])
  let latentBatch :
      Tensor α [heads, pastTokens + 1, kvLatentDim] :=
    Tensor.broadcastTo
      (Shape.CanBroadcastTo.dim_1_to_n
        (Shape.CanBroadcastTo.dim_eq
          (Shape.CanBroadcastTo.dim_eq
            (Shape.CanBroadcastTo.scalarTo [])))) latentBatchSource
  let sharedBatchSource :
      Tensor α [1, pastTokens + 1, sharedKeyDim] :=
    Tensor.reshapeSpec sharedKeyCache (by simp [Shape.size])
  let sharedBatch :
      Tensor α [heads, pastTokens + 1, sharedKeyDim] :=
    Tensor.broadcastTo
      (Shape.CanBroadcastTo.dim_1_to_n
        (Shape.CanBroadcastTo.dim_eq
          (Shape.CanBroadcastTo.dim_eq
            (Shape.CanBroadcastTo.scalarTo [])))) sharedBatchSource
  let sameBatch := Shape.CanBroadcastTo.refl [heads]
  let queryContent := Tensor.matmulSpec sameBatch sameBatch queryBatch layer.queryContentUp
  let queryShared := Tensor.matmulSpec sameBatch sameBatch queryBatch layer.querySharedUp
  let keys := Tensor.matmulSpec sameBatch sameBatch latentBatch layer.keyUp
  let values := Tensor.matmulSpec sameBatch sameBatch latentBatch layer.valueUp
  let contentScores := Tensor.matmulSpec sameBatch sameBatch queryContent
    (Tensor.swapAdjacentAxes keys 1)
  let sharedScores :=
    Tensor.matmulSpec sameBatch sameBatch queryShared (Tensor.swapAdjacentAxes sharedBatch 1)
  let scoreShape : Shape := [heads, 1, pastTokens + 1]
  let scores := Tensor.mulSpec (Tensor.full scoreShape scoreScale)
    (Tensor.addSpec contentScores sharedScores)
  let headOutput3 := Tensor.matmulSpec sameBatch sameBatch
    (Activation.softmaxSpec 2 scores) values
  let headOutput : Tensor α [heads, valueDim] :=
    Tensor.reshapeSpec headOutput3 (by simp [Shape.size])
  let gateMatrix : Tensor α [modelDim, heads * valueDim] :=
    Tensor.reshapeSpec layer.gateWeight (by simp [Shape.size])
  let gateFlat := vecMatMulSpec x gateMatrix
  let gate : Tensor α [heads, valueDim] :=
    Activation.sigmoidSpec (Tensor.reshapeSpec gateFlat (by simp [Shape.size]))
  let gatedHeads := Tensor.mulSpec gate headOutput
  let gatedFlat : Tensor α [heads * valueDim] :=
    Tensor.reshapeSpec gatedHeads (by simp [Shape.size])
  let outputMatrix : Tensor α [heads * valueDim, modelDim] :=
    Tensor.reshapeSpec layer.outputWeight (by simp [Shape.size, Nat.mul_assoc])
  (latentCache, sharedKeyCache, vecMatMulSpec gatedFlat outputMatrix)

/-- One causal MLA token step, which appends the current entry before evaluating attention. -/
def step
    (layer :
      GatedMLA α modelDim heads queryLatentDim kvLatentDim contentKeyDim sharedKeyDim valueDim)
    (cache : Cache α kvLatentDim sharedKeyDim) (x : Tensor α [modelDim]) :
    Cache α kvLatentDim sharedKeyDim × Tensor α [modelDim] :=
  let queryLatent := RMSNorm.scale (vecMatMulSpec x layer.queryDown) layer.queryNormScale
  let currentKV := RMSNorm.scale (vecMatMulSpec x layer.kvDown) layer.kvNormScale
  let current : Entry α kvLatentDim sharedKeyDim :=
    { latent := currentKV, sharedKey := vecMatMulSpec x layer.sharedKeyDown }
  let cache' := cache ++ [current]
  let headOutput := fun h => layer.attend h queryLatent cache'
  let gate := fun h channel => Activation.Math.sigmoidSpec <|
    (List.finRange modelDim).foldl (fun total input =>
      total + Tensor.getScalar x input * get2 (Spec.get layer.gateWeight input) h channel) 0
  let output := Tensor.stackLeading (fun feature => Tensor.scalar <|
    (List.finRange heads).foldl (fun acrossHeads h =>
      (List.finRange valueDim).foldl (fun total channel =>
        total + gate h channel * Tensor.getScalar (headOutput h) channel *
          get2 (Spec.get layer.outputWeight h) channel feature) acrossHeads) 0)
  (cache', output)

/-- One MLA step appends one entry to the streaming cache. -/
theorem step_cache_length
    (layer :
      GatedMLA α modelDim heads queryLatentDim kvLatentDim contentKeyDim sharedKeyDim valueDim)
    (cache : Cache α kvLatentDim sharedKeyDim) (x : Tensor α [modelDim]) :
    (layer.step cache x).1.length = cache.length + 1 := by
  simp [step]

/-- An MLA token step keeps the old cache as a prefix. -/
theorem step_cache_prefix
    (layer :
      GatedMLA α modelDim heads queryLatentDim kvLatentDim contentKeyDim sharedKeyDim valueDim)
    (cache : Cache α kvLatentDim sharedKeyDim) (x : Tensor α [modelDim]) :
    cache <+: (layer.step cache x).1 := by
  simp [step]

/-- Running MLA over a token list grows the compressed cache by the list's length. -/
theorem run_cache_length
    (layer :
      GatedMLA α modelDim heads queryLatentDim kvLatentDim contentKeyDim sharedKeyDim valueDim)
    (cache : Cache α kvLatentDim sharedKeyDim)
    (tokens : List (Tensor α [modelDim])) :
    (CausalScan.run layer.step cache tokens).1.length = cache.length + tokens.length := by
  induction tokens generalizing cache with
  | nil => simp
  | cons token rest ih =>
      simp only [CausalScan.run]
      rw [ih]
      rw [step_cache_length]
      simp [Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_left_comm]

/-- Chunking a Gated MLA causal pass preserves its cache and outputs. -/
theorem run_append
    (layer :
      GatedMLA α modelDim heads queryLatentDim kvLatentDim contentKeyDim sharedKeyDim valueDim)
    (cache : Cache α kvLatentDim sharedKeyDim)
    (left right : List (Tensor α [modelDim])) :
    CausalScan.run layer.step cache (left ++ right) =
      let first := CausalScan.run layer.step cache left
      let second := CausalScan.run layer.step first.1 right
      (second.1, first.2 ++ second.2) :=
  CausalScan.run_append layer.step cache left right

end GatedMLA

end KimiK3

module

public import KimiK3.Common
public import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Log.Basic

/-!
# MOPD rewards

The MOPD reward of a sampled token is the clipped teacher-to-student log probability ratio.
The probability subtype excludes zero, so the logarithm is always defined. Theorems below prove
the reward interval and show the reward vanishes when the two probabilities agree. Teacher selection
and the runtime stop-gradient are outside this file.

Reference: Kimi K3 technical report, Section 2.5 and Sections 3--4, pp. 10--14.
https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24653.
-/

@[expose] public section

namespace KimiK3

open Spec TorchLean
open Tensor
open scoped BigOperators

namespace MOPD

/-- A strictly positive probability, safe inside the logarithm of the MOPD reward.

Teacher and student probabilities in Eq. 15 come from softmax distributions, so they are
strictly positive. This is Mathlib's interval subtype.
-/
abbrev StrictProbability := Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) 1

/-- Symmetric clipping to `[-bound, bound]`. -/
noncomputable def clip (bound value : ℝ) : ℝ := max (-bound) (min bound value)

/-- Per-token teacher/student reward from Eq. 15, before the stop-gradient annotation. -/
noncomputable def reward (maxReward : ℝ)
    (teacherProbability studentProbability : StrictProbability) : ℝ :=
  clip maxReward (Real.log ((teacherProbability : ℝ) / studentProbability))

/-- Clipping does not change a value already inside the requested symmetric interval. -/
theorem clip_eq_self {bound value : ℝ} (hlower : -bound ≤ value) (hupper : value ≤ bound) :
    clip bound value = value := by
  rw [clip, min_eq_right hupper, max_eq_right hlower]

/-- Clipping enforces the report's reward interval for every log-ratio. -/
theorem reward_mem_interval {maxReward : ℝ} (h : 0 ≤ maxReward)
    (teacherProbability studentProbability : StrictProbability) :
    -maxReward ≤ reward maxReward teacherProbability studentProbability ∧
      reward maxReward teacherProbability studentProbability ≤ maxReward := by
  constructor
  · exact le_max_left _ _
  · exact max_le (by linarith) (min_le_left _ _)

/-- A teacher and student assigning the same probability receive zero MOPD reward. -/
@[simp]
theorem reward_self {maxReward : ℝ} (hMaxReward : 0 ≤ maxReward)
    (probability : StrictProbability) :
    reward maxReward probability probability = 0 := by
  have hne : (probability : ℝ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt probability.property.1
  rw [reward, div_self hne, Real.log_one]
  exact clip_eq_self (neg_nonpos.mpr hMaxReward) hMaxReward

end MOPD

end KimiK3

module

public import KimiK3.Model
public import Mathlib.Data.Fin.VecNotation
public import NN.Proofs.Analysis.Softmax
public import NN.Proofs.Tensor.Basic.Algebra
public import NN.Tensor
public import Mathlib.Geometry.Convex.ConvexSpace.Defs
public import Mathlib.Data.EReal.Basic
import Mathlib.Algebra.Order.Group.MinMax
import NN.Proofs.Tensor.Basic.LinearAlgebra

/-!
# EAGLE-3 draft model and speculative sampling

Read three depth features from the target model, fuse them with a token embedding, and run
the draft transition. A separate finite-distribution calculation proves that accepted
proposal mass plus corrected rejection mass equals the target distribution. This probability
identity does not verify a deployed sampler's random-number generator or cache restoration.

Reference: Kimi K3 technical report, Section 2.5 and Sections 3--4, pp. 10--14.
https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24653.
-/

@[expose] public section

namespace KimiK3

open Spec TorchLean
open Tensor
open scoped BigOperators

namespace Draft

namespace Features

/-- Read the first, fourth, and final AttnRes block outputs named by the K3 report. The hypothesis
rules out applying the EAGLE-3 head before four block outputs exist. -/
def ofBlockState {hiddenDim : Nat} (state : AttnRes.BlockState ℝ hiddenDim)
    (hFour : 4 ≤ state.blockOutputs.length) : Tensor ℝ [3, hiddenDim] :=
  let outputs := state.blockOutputs
  have hFourOutputs : 4 ≤ outputs.length := by simpa [outputs] using hFour
  have hNonempty : outputs ≠ [] := List.ne_nil_of_length_pos (by omega)
  Tensor.stackLeading ![outputs.get ⟨0, by omega⟩,
    outputs.get ⟨3, by omega⟩, outputs.getLast hNonempty]

end Features

namespace LanguageModel

/-- Extract the EAGLE-3 feature triplet for one token after a target-model forward pass.
Features come from that token's retained AttnRes state. -/
noncomputable def eagleFeaturesAt {cfg : TextConfig} {decayRank sequenceLength : Nat}
    (model : LanguageModel ℝ cfg decayRank)
    (embeddings : Tensor ℝ [sequenceLength, cfg.hiddenDim])
    (position : Fin sequenceLength)
    (hFour : 4 ≤ (model.forwardDepthStates embeddings position).blockOutputs.length) :
    Tensor ℝ [3, cfg.hiddenDim] :=
  Features.ofBlockState (model.forwardDepthStates embeddings position) hFour

end LanguageModel

namespace FeatureFusion

variable {hiddenDim : Nat}

/-- Multiplying a real vector by an all-zero square matrix gives the zero vector. -/
@[simp]
private theorem vecMatMul_fill_zero (values : Tensor ℝ [hiddenDim]) :
    vecMatMulSpec values (Tensor.zeros [hiddenDim, hiddenDim]) =
      Tensor.zeros [hiddenDim] := by
  apply Tensor.ext_vector
  intro column
  rw [getScalar_vec_mat_mul_spec]
  simp

/-- Multiplying a real row vector by the identity matrix returns that vector. -/
@[simp]
private theorem vecMatMul_identity (values : Tensor ℝ [hiddenDim]) :
    vecMatMulSpec values (identityTensorSpec hiddenDim) = values := by
  let result := vecMatMulSpec values (identityTensorSpec hiddenDim)
  have coordinates : Tensor.getScalar result = Tensor.getScalar values := by
    funext column
    simp [result, getScalar_vec_mat_mul_spec, get2_identityTensorSpec]
  exact Tensor.ext_vector (fun column => congrFun coordinates column)

variable {α : Type} [Storage α] [Context α]

/-- Concatenate-and-project written as a sum of three matrix products. -/
def forward (fusion : Tensor α [3, hiddenDim, hiddenDim]) (features : Tensor α [3, hiddenDim]) :
    Tensor α [hiddenDim] :=
  addSpec
    (addSpec
      (vecMatMulSpec (Spec.get features 0) (Spec.get fusion 0))
      (vecMatMulSpec (Spec.get features 1) (Spec.get fusion 1)))
    (vecMatMulSpec (Spec.get features 2) (Spec.get fusion 2))

/-- With the report's `[0 0 I]` initialization, fusion returns the high-level feature. -/
theorem initial_fusion_eq_high (features : Tensor ℝ [3, hiddenDim])
    (fusion : Tensor ℝ [3, hiddenDim, hiddenDim])
    (hLow : (Spec.get fusion 0) = Tensor.zeros [hiddenDim, hiddenDim])
    (hMiddle : (Spec.get fusion 1) = Tensor.zeros [hiddenDim, hiddenDim])
    (hHigh : (Spec.get fusion 2) = identityTensorSpec hiddenDim) :
    FeatureFusion.forward fusion features = (Spec.get features 2) := by
  rw [forward, hLow, hMiddle, hHigh]
  rw [vecMatMul_fill_zero, vecMatMul_fill_zero, vecMatMul_identity]
  simp

end FeatureFusion

/-- One-layer MTP/EAGLE-3 draft head. Its two input matrices represent the bias-free linear map
applied to the concatenation of the current token embedding and fused target feature. The decoder
layer has the same KDA-or-MLA and channel-mixer structure as a backbone layer. -/
structure Model (cfg : TextConfig) (decayRank : Nat) where
  /-- Three-source feature-fusion projection. -/
  featureFusion : Tensor ℝ [3, cfg.hiddenDim, cfg.hiddenDim]
  /-- Token embedding table shared with the draft input path. -/
  tokenEmbedding : Tensor ℝ [cfg.vocabSize, cfg.hiddenDim]
  /-- Projection applied to the current token embedding. -/
  tokenInputWeight : Tensor ℝ [cfg.hiddenDim, cfg.hiddenDim]
  /-- Projection applied to the fused target-model feature. -/
  featureInputWeight : Tensor ℝ [cfg.hiddenDim, cfg.hiddenDim]
  /-- Single causal decoder layer used by the draft model. -/
  decoderLayer : BackboneLayer ℝ cfg decayRank
  /-- Query used to read the draft layer's final AttnRes depth state. -/
  finalQuery : Tensor ℝ [cfg.hiddenDim]
  /-- RMS-normalization scale before the vocabulary projection. -/
  finalNormScale : Tensor ℝ [cfg.hiddenDim]
  /-- Projection from hidden states to draft-token logits. -/
  vocabularyHead : Tensor ℝ [cfg.hiddenDim, cfg.vocabSize]
  vocabSize_pos : 0 < cfg.vocabSize
  activeExperts_le : cfg.activeExperts ≤ cfg.numRoutedExperts

namespace Model

variable {cfg : TextConfig} {decayRank : Nat}

/-- Form a draft decoder input from a token embedding and one already fused feature. The feature is
the target model's three-level fusion at the first training-time-test step and the preceding draft
hidden state at every later step. -/
noncomputable def inputFromFeature (model : Model cfg decayRank) (token : Fin cfg.vocabSize)
    (feature : Tensor ℝ [cfg.hiddenDim]) : Tensor ℝ [cfg.hiddenDim] :=
  vecMatMulSpec (Spec.get model.tokenEmbedding token) model.tokenInputWeight +
    vecMatMulSpec feature model.featureInputWeight

/-- Form the first draft input by fusing the low-, middle-, and high-level target features. -/
noncomputable def input (model : Model cfg decayRank) (token : Fin cfg.vocabSize)
    (features : Tensor ℝ [3, cfg.hiddenDim]) : Tensor ℝ [cfg.hiddenDim] :=
  model.inputFromFeature token (FeatureFusion.forward model.featureFusion features)

/-- Causal KDA or MLA state retained by the single draft decoder layer. -/
abbrev CausalState (model : Model cfg decayRank) :=
  model.decoderLayer.sequence.CausalState

/-- Empty causal state at the beginning of a draft window. -/
noncomputable def initialState (model : Model cfg decayRank) : model.CausalState :=
  model.decoderLayer.sequence.initialState

/-- Advance the draft decoder from one fused feature, returning the sequence-mixer state for the
next draft position and the normalized hidden state. -/
noncomputable def stepHiddenFromFeature (model : Model cfg decayRank) (state : model.CausalState)
    (token : Fin cfg.vocabSize) (feature : Tensor ℝ [cfg.hiddenDim]) :
    model.CausalState × Tensor ℝ [cfg.hiddenDim] :=
  let depthState := BackboneLayer.initialDepthState (model.inputFromFeature token feature)
  let result := model.decoderLayer.forwardToken model.activeExperts_le state depthState
  (result.1, RMSNorm.scale (result.2.retrieve model.finalQuery) model.finalNormScale)

/-- Advance the first draft position from target-model features. Later training-time-test positions
use `stepHiddenFromFeature` with the preceding draft hidden state. -/
noncomputable def stepHidden (model : Model cfg decayRank) (state : model.CausalState)
    (token : Fin cfg.vocabSize) (features : Tensor ℝ [3, cfg.hiddenDim]) :
    model.CausalState × Tensor ℝ [cfg.hiddenDim] :=
  model.stepHiddenFromFeature state token (FeatureFusion.forward model.featureFusion features)

/-- Run the first draft position from an empty causal state. -/
noncomputable def forwardHidden (model : Model cfg decayRank)
    (token : Fin cfg.vocabSize) (features : Tensor ℝ [3, cfg.hiddenDim]) :
    Tensor ℝ [cfg.hiddenDim] :=
  (model.stepHidden model.initialState token features).2

/-- Advance one causal draft position and return its next-token logits. -/
noncomputable def stepLogits (model : Model cfg decayRank) (state : model.CausalState)
    (token : Fin cfg.vocabSize) (features : Tensor ℝ [3, cfg.hiddenDim]) :
    model.CausalState × Tensor ℝ [cfg.vocabSize] :=
  let result := model.stepHidden state token features
  (result.1, vecMatMulSpec result.2 model.vocabularyHead)

/-- Advance one continuation position using the preceding draft hidden state as the feature
input. -/
noncomputable def stepLogitsFromFeature (model : Model cfg decayRank) (state : model.CausalState)
    (token : Fin cfg.vocabSize) (feature : Tensor ℝ [cfg.hiddenDim]) :
    model.CausalState ×
      (Tensor ℝ [cfg.hiddenDim] × Tensor ℝ [cfg.vocabSize]) :=
  let result := model.stepHiddenFromFeature state token feature
  (result.1, result.2, vecMatMulSpec result.2 model.vocabularyHead)

/-- Draft next-token logits. -/
noncomputable def logits (model : Model cfg decayRank)
    (token : Fin cfg.vocabSize) (features : Tensor ℝ [3, cfg.hiddenDim]) :
    Tensor ℝ [cfg.vocabSize] :=
  (model.stepLogits model.initialState token features).2

/-- With the report's `[0 0 I]` initialization, the EAGLE-3 fused input equals the pretrained MTP
input built from the high-level feature alone. This is why the draft head can start from the MTP
layer. -/
theorem input_at_eagle_initialization (model : Model cfg decayRank)
    (token : Fin cfg.vocabSize) (features : Tensor ℝ [3, cfg.hiddenDim])
    (hLow : (Spec.get model.featureFusion 0) =
      Tensor.zeros [cfg.hiddenDim, cfg.hiddenDim])
    (hMiddle : (Spec.get model.featureFusion 1) =
      Tensor.zeros [cfg.hiddenDim, cfg.hiddenDim])
    (hHigh : (Spec.get model.featureFusion 2) = identityTensorSpec cfg.hiddenDim) :
    model.input token features =
      vecMatMulSpec (Spec.get model.tokenEmbedding token) model.tokenInputWeight +
        vecMatMulSpec (Spec.get features 2) model.featureInputWeight := by
  rw [input, inputFromFeature,
    FeatureFusion.initial_fusion_eq_high features model.featureFusion hLow hMiddle hHigh]

end Model

/-- A probability vector over the finite vocabulary, as a point of Mathlib's standard simplex. -/
abbrev Distribution (vocabSize : Nat) := Convexity.StdSimplex ℝ (Fin vocabSize)

namespace Distribution

/-- Interpret a nonempty vocabulary-logit vector as a probability distribution through TorchLean's
stable softmax specification. Positivity and normalization come from TorchLean's softmax
theorems, not from new assumptions. -/
noncomputable def ofLogits {vocabSize : Nat} (hVocab : 0 < vocabSize)
    (logits : Tensor ℝ [vocabSize]) : Distribution vocabSize := by
  cases vocabSize with
  | zero => omega
  | succ n =>
      let probabilities := Activation.softmaxVecSpec logits
      exact {
        weights := Finsupp.equivFunOnFinite.symm (Tensor.getScalar probabilities)
        nonneg := fun token => by
          simpa using le_of_lt (Proofs.softmax_vec_spec_pos logits token)
        total := by
          simpa [Finsupp.sum_fintype, probabilities, Spec.sum_spec_vec] using
            Proofs.sum_spec_softmax_vec_spec logits }

end Distribution

/-- Target-model distribution at one sequence position, computed from the logits of the complete
K3 language backbone. -/
noncomputable def targetDistributionAt {cfg : TextConfig} {decayRank sequenceLength : Nat}
    (model : LanguageModel ℝ cfg decayRank)
    (embeddings : Tensor ℝ [sequenceLength, cfg.hiddenDim])
    (position : Fin sequenceLength) : Distribution cfg.vocabSize :=
  Distribution.ofLogits model.vocabSize_pos (Spec.get (model.logits embeddings) position)

namespace Model

/-- Next-token distribution emitted by the EAGLE-3 draft head. -/
noncomputable def distribution (model : Model cfg decayRank)
    (token : Fin cfg.vocabSize) (features : Tensor ℝ [3, cfg.hiddenDim]) :
    Distribution cfg.vocabSize :=
  Distribution.ofLogits model.vocabSize_pos (model.logits token features)

/-- Advance one causal draft position and return the normalized distribution used by lossless
speculative sampling. -/
noncomputable def stepDistribution (model : Model cfg decayRank) (state : model.CausalState)
    (token : Fin cfg.vocabSize) (features : Tensor ℝ [3, cfg.hiddenDim]) :
    model.CausalState × Distribution cfg.vocabSize :=
  let result := model.stepLogits state token features
  (result.1, Distribution.ofLogits model.vocabSize_pos result.2)

/-- Advance a continuation position and expose both the hidden feature fed into the next step and
the normalized token distribution. -/
noncomputable def stepDistributionFromFeature (model : Model cfg decayRank)
    (state : model.CausalState) (token : Fin cfg.vocabSize)
    (feature : Tensor ℝ [cfg.hiddenDim]) :
    model.CausalState ×
      (Tensor ℝ [cfg.hiddenDim] × Distribution cfg.vocabSize) :=
  let result := model.stepLogitsFromFeature state token feature
  (result.1, result.2.1, Distribution.ofLogits model.vocabSize_pos result.2.2)

end Model

/-- Lossless speculative-sampling acceptance rate `Σ_x min(p(x), q(x))`. -/
noncomputable def acceptanceRate {vocabSize : Nat}
    (target draft : Distribution vocabSize) : ℝ :=
  ∑ token, min (target.weights token) (draft.weights token)

/-- Total-variation distance between target and draft next-token distributions. -/
noncomputable def totalVariation {vocabSize : Nat}
    (target draft : Distribution vocabSize) : ℝ :=
  (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ token, |target.weights token - draft.weights token|

/-- Swapping target and draft does not change speculative acceptance. -/
theorem acceptanceRate_comm {vocabSize : Nat} (target draft : Distribution vocabSize) :
    acceptanceRate target draft = acceptanceRate draft target := by
  simp only [acceptanceRate, min_comm]

/-- Total variation is nonnegative. -/
theorem totalVariation_nonneg {vocabSize : Nat} (target draft : Distribution vocabSize) :
    0 ≤ totalVariation target draft :=
  mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (Finset.sum_nonneg fun _ _ => abs_nonneg _)

/-- Acceptance rates lie in `[0, 1]`. -/
theorem acceptanceRate_mem_unitInterval {vocabSize : Nat}
    (target draft : Distribution vocabSize) :
    0 ≤ acceptanceRate target draft ∧ acceptanceRate target draft ≤ 1 := by
  constructor
  · exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun token _ =>
      le_min (target.nonneg token) (draft.nonneg token))
  · calc
      acceptanceRate target draft
          ≤ ∑ token, target.weights token :=
            Finset.sum_le_sum (fun token _ => min_le_left _ _)
      _ = 1 := target.total_of_fintype

/-- Speculative acceptance equals one minus the total-variation distance, so the Eq. 16 loss
`-log(acceptance)` depends on target and draft only through that distance. -/
theorem acceptanceRate_eq_one_sub_totalVariation {vocabSize : Nat}
    (target draft : Distribution vocabSize) :
    acceptanceRate target draft = 1 - totalVariation target draft := by
  have htarget : ∑ token, target.weights token = 1 := by
    exact target.total_of_fintype
  have hdraft : ∑ token, draft.weights token = 1 := by
    exact draft.total_of_fintype
  have hpointwise : ∀ token : Fin vocabSize,
      min (target.weights token) (draft.weights token) =
        (target.weights token + draft.weights token - |target.weights token - draft.weights token|) / 2 := by
    intro token
    by_cases h : target.weights token ≤ draft.weights token
    · rw [min_eq_left h, abs_of_nonpos (sub_nonpos.mpr h)]
      ring_nf
    · have h' : draft.weights token ≤ target.weights token := le_of_not_ge h
      rw [min_eq_right h', abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr h')]
      ring_nf
  rw [acceptanceRate, totalVariation]
  simp_rw [hpointwise]
  rw [← Finset.sum_div]
  rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_add_distrib,
    htarget, hdraft]
  ring_nf

/-- Speculative acceptance is perfect exactly when the draft and target distributions agree. -/
theorem acceptanceRate_eq_one_iff {vocabSize : Nat}
    (target draft : Distribution vocabSize) :
    acceptanceRate target draft = 1 ↔ target = draft := by
  constructor
  · intro hAcceptance
    have hIdentity := acceptanceRate_eq_one_sub_totalVariation target draft
    rw [hAcceptance] at hIdentity
    have hVariation : totalVariation target draft = 0 := by linarith
    have hSum : ∑ token, |target.weights token - draft.weights token| = 0 := by
      rw [totalVariation] at hVariation
      linarith
    apply Convexity.StdSimplex.ext
    apply Finsupp.ext
    intro token
    have hCoordinate :
        |target.weights token - draft.weights token| = 0 :=
      (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg fun _ _ => abs_nonneg _).mp hSum token
        (Finset.mem_univ token)
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp (abs_eq_zero.mp hCoordinate)
  · rintro rfl
    rw [acceptanceRate]
    simp only [min_self]
    exact target.total_of_fintype

/-- Rejection probability: the target mass not shared with the draft. -/
noncomputable def residualMass {vocabSize : Nat}
    (target draft : Distribution vocabSize) : ℝ :=
  1 - acceptanceRate target draft

/-- Unnormalized correction mass for one token after speculative rejection. -/
noncomputable def residualNumerator {vocabSize : Nat}
    (target draft : Distribution vocabSize) (token : Fin vocabSize) : ℝ :=
  max 0 (target.weights token - draft.weights token)

/-- The positive part of `target - draft` is the target mass not covered by acceptance. -/
theorem residualNumerator_eq_sub_min {vocabSize : Nat}
    (target draft : Distribution vocabSize) (token : Fin vocabSize) :
    residualNumerator target draft token =
      target.weights token - min (target.weights token) (draft.weights token) := by
  simpa only [residualNumerator, sub_self] using
    (max_sub_sub_left (target.weights token) (target.weights token) (draft.weights token))

/-- Correction numerators sum to the rejection probability. -/
theorem sum_residualNumerator {vocabSize : Nat}
    (target draft : Distribution vocabSize) :
    ∑ token, residualNumerator target draft token = residualMass target draft := by
  have htarget : ∑ token, target.weights token = 1 := by
    exact target.total_of_fintype
  simp_rw [residualNumerator_eq_sub_min]
  rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, htarget]
  rfl

/-- Distribution sampled after a rejection, defined when target and draft differ (acceptance below
one). Its density is the normalized positive part of `target - draft`. -/
noncomputable def correctionDistribution {vocabSize : Nat}
    (target draft : Distribution vocabSize)
    (hReject : acceptanceRate target draft < 1) : Distribution vocabSize := by
  have hMass : 0 < residualMass target draft := by
    simpa [residualMass] using sub_pos.mpr hReject
  exact {
    weights := Finsupp.equivFunOnFinite.symm
      (fun token => residualNumerator target draft token / residualMass target draft)
    nonneg := fun token => by
      simpa [residualNumerator] using
        div_nonneg (le_max_left 0 (target.weights token - draft.weights token)) hMass.le
    total := by
      simpa [Finsupp.sum_fintype, ← Finset.sum_div, sum_residualNumerator] using
        div_self (ne_of_gt hMass) }

/-- One-token speculative sampling is lossless. For every token, the mass accepted from the draft
plus the mass drawn from the rejection correction equals the target-model mass. -/
theorem accepted_add_corrected_eq_target {vocabSize : Nat}
    (target draft : Distribution vocabSize)
    (hReject : acceptanceRate target draft < 1) (token : Fin vocabSize) :
    min (target.weights token) (draft.weights token) +
        residualMass target draft *
          (correctionDistribution target draft hReject).weights token =
      target.weights token := by
  have hMass : residualMass target draft ≠ 0 := by
    apply ne_of_gt
    simpa [residualMass] using sub_pos.mpr hReject
  rw [correctionDistribution]
  change min (target.weights token) (draft.weights token) +
      residualMass target draft *
        (residualNumerator target draft token / residualMass target draft) =
    target.weights token
  rw [mul_div_cancel₀ _ hMass]
  rw [residualNumerator_eq_sub_min]
  ring

namespace Model

/-- State of EAGLE-3 training-time testing after target features have been fused once. The second
component is the draft hidden feature consumed by the following step. -/
abbrev TrainingTimeTestState (model : Model cfg decayRank) :=
  model.CausalState × Tensor ℝ [cfg.hiddenDim]

/-- Initial training-time-test state: an empty draft cache and the fused target-model feature. -/
noncomputable def initialTrainingTimeTestState (model : Model cfg decayRank)
    (features : Tensor ℝ [3, cfg.hiddenDim]) : model.TrainingTimeTestState :=
  (model.initialState, FeatureFusion.forward model.featureFusion features)

/-- One EAGLE-3 training-time-test transition. It consumes the current token and
feature, then stores its own hidden output as the feature for the next transition. No fresh
target-model feature is requested after initialization. -/
noncomputable def trainingTimeTestStep (model : Model cfg decayRank) :
    model.TrainingTimeTestState → Fin cfg.vocabSize →
      model.TrainingTimeTestState × Distribution cfg.vocabSize :=
  fun state token =>
    let result := model.stepDistributionFromFeature state.1 token state.2
    ((result.1, result.2.1), result.2.2)

/-- Run EAGLE-3 training-time testing over shifted training tokens, starting from the fused
target-model features. Kimi K3 supplies seven tokens. -/
noncomputable def trainingTimeTest (model : Model cfg decayRank)
    (tokens : List (Fin cfg.vocabSize)) (features : Tensor ℝ [3, cfg.hiddenDim]) :
    model.TrainingTimeTestState × List (Distribution cfg.vocabSize) :=
  CausalScan.run model.trainingTimeTestStep
    (model.initialTrainingTimeTestState features) tokens

/-- Training-time testing emits one draft distribution for every shifted training token. -/
theorem trainingTimeTest_length (model : Model cfg decayRank)
    (tokens : List (Fin cfg.vocabSize)) (features : Tensor ℝ [3, cfg.hiddenDim]) :
    (model.trainingTimeTest tokens features).2.length = tokens.length :=
  CausalScan.outputs_length model.trainingTimeTestStep
    (model.initialTrainingTimeTestState features) tokens

/-- Splitting a training-time-test token sequence into chunks does not change its final state or
draft distributions, so the seven reported steps can be replayed incrementally. -/
theorem trainingTimeTest_append (model : Model cfg decayRank)
    (initialTokens remainingTokens : List (Fin cfg.vocabSize))
    (features : Tensor ℝ [3, cfg.hiddenDim]) :
    model.trainingTimeTest (initialTokens ++ remainingTokens) features =
      let first := model.trainingTimeTest initialTokens features
      let second := CausalScan.run model.trainingTimeTestStep first.1 remainingTokens
      (second.1, first.2 ++ second.2) := by
  exact CausalScan.run_append model.trainingTimeTestStep
    (model.initialTrainingTimeTestState features) initialTokens remainingTokens

/-- The seven draft distributions used by K3 fine-tuning. Indexing by `Fin 7` puts the reported
training-time-test depth into the type. -/
noncomputable def sevenStepDistributions (model : Model cfg decayRank)
    (tokens : Fin 7 → Fin cfg.vocabSize) (features : Tensor ℝ [3, cfg.hiddenDim]) :
    Fin 7 → Distribution cfg.vocabSize := by
  let outputs := (model.trainingTimeTest (List.ofFn tokens) features).2
  have hLength : outputs.length = 7 := by
    rw [model.trainingTimeTest_length]
    simp
  exact fun step => outputs.get ⟨step.val, by rw [hLength]; exact step.isLt⟩

end Model

/-- Likelihood-based draft loss in Eq. 16.

The codomain is `EReal` because disjoint target and draft distributions have zero acceptance and
so infinite negative-log loss.  Lean's convention `Real.log 0 = 0` would hide that case.
-/
noncomputable def likelihoodLoss {vocabSize : Nat}
    (target draft : Distribution vocabSize) : EReal :=
  if acceptanceRate target draft = 0 then ⊤
  else ((-Real.log (acceptanceRate target draft) : ℝ) : EReal)

/-- Likelihood loss is infinite exactly when the acceptance rate is zero. -/
theorem likelihoodLoss_eq_top_iff {vocabSize : Nat}
    (target draft : Distribution vocabSize) :
    likelihoodLoss target draft = ⊤ ↔ acceptanceRate target draft = 0 := by
  simp [likelihoodLoss]

/-- At positive acceptance, the extended loss agrees with the ordinary real negative log. -/
theorem likelihoodLoss_eq_neg_log_of_pos {vocabSize : Nat}
    (target draft : Distribution vocabSize)
    (hAcceptance : 0 < acceptanceRate target draft) :
    likelihoodLoss target draft =
      ((-Real.log (acceptanceRate target draft) : ℝ) : EReal) := by
  simp [likelihoodLoss, ne_of_gt hAcceptance]

namespace Model

/-- Kimi K3's seven-step EAGLE-3 objective against a frozen target language model. Each target
distribution comes from the target model at the corresponding training position, and each draft
distribution comes from the recurrent training-time-test pass. As in Eq. 16 of the report, there
is no auxiliary ground-truth cross-entropy term. -/
noncomputable def sevenStepLikelihoodLoss {targetDecayRank draftDecayRank sequenceLength : Nat}
    (target : LanguageModel ℝ cfg targetDecayRank) (draft : Model cfg draftDecayRank)
    (embeddings : Tensor ℝ [sequenceLength, cfg.hiddenDim])
    (positions : Fin 7 → Fin sequenceLength) (tokens : Fin 7 → Fin cfg.vocabSize)
    (features : Tensor ℝ [3, cfg.hiddenDim]) : EReal :=
  ∑ step : Fin 7,
    likelihoodLoss (targetDistributionAt target embeddings (positions step))
      (draft.sevenStepDistributions tokens features step)

end Model

end Draft

module

public import KimiK3.Common
public import NN.MLTheory.Optimization.Muon
public import NN.Proofs.Tensor.Basic.Algebra

/-!
# Per-head Muon

Split a projection's output columns into head blocks, apply a supplied orthogonalizer to each
block, and reassemble the original layout. Split and merge laws prove this is a reversible
reindexing. Properties of the orthogonalized blocks come from the supplied orthogonalizer's
contract, so no particular iterative algorithm is proved correct here.

Reference: Kimi K3 technical report, Section 2.5 and Sections 3--4, pp. 10--14.
https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24653.
-/

@[expose] public section

namespace KimiK3

open Spec TorchLean
open Tensor
open scoped BigOperators

namespace PerHeadMuon

open Optim.Muon

/-- One momentum matrix for every attention head. -/
abbrev HeadMatrices (α : Type) [Storage α] (heads rows columns : Nat) :=
  Fin heads → MatrixTensor α rows columns

/-- Partition a projection matrix along its output-head axis.

For a matrix of shape `rows × (heads * columns)`, output column `(head, column)` belongs to the
`head`-th `rows × columns` block. Per-Head Muon uses this layout to treat the Q, K, and V momentum
buffers head by head.
-/
def split {α : Type} [Storage α] {heads rows columns : Nat}
    (momentum : MatrixTensor α rows (heads * columns)) :
    HeadMatrices α heads rows columns :=
  fun head => Tensor.stackLeading fun row => Tensor.stackLeading fun column =>
    Tensor.scalar (get2 momentum row (finProdFinEquiv (head, column)))

/-- Reassemble per-head matrices into the original projection layout. -/
def merge {α : Type} [Storage α] {heads rows columns : Nat}
    (blocks : HeadMatrices α heads rows columns) :
    MatrixTensor α rows (heads * columns) :=
  Tensor.stackLeading fun row => Tensor.stackLeading fun outputColumn =>
    let headColumn := finProdFinEquiv.symm outputColumn
    Tensor.scalar (get2 (blocks headColumn.1) row headColumn.2)

/-- Splitting and reassembling a projection momentum matrix preserves every entry. -/
theorem merge_split {α : Type} [Storage α] {heads rows columns : Nat}
    (momentum : MatrixTensor α rows (heads * columns)) :
    merge (split momentum) = momentum := by
  apply TorchLean.Tensor.Internal.Rep.ext
  rintro ⟨row, column, ⟨⟩⟩
  have h : get2 (merge (split momentum)) row column = get2 momentum row column := by
    simp only [merge, split, Tensor.stackLeading, Spec.get2_dim, Prod.mk.eta,
      Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
  simpa only [Spec.get2_eq_apply] using h

/-- Reassembling and splitting an indexed head family returns the same family. -/
theorem split_merge {α : Type} [Storage α] {heads rows columns : Nat}
    (blocks : HeadMatrices α heads rows columns) :
    split (merge blocks) = blocks := by
  funext head
  apply TorchLean.Tensor.Internal.Rep.ext
  rintro ⟨row, column, ⟨⟩⟩
  have h : get2 (split (merge blocks) head) row column = get2 (blocks head) row column := by
    simp only [merge, split, Tensor.stackLeading, Spec.get2_dim, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
  simpa only [Spec.get2_eq_apply] using h

/-- Orthogonalize every output-head block independently and restore the projection layout. -/
def orthogonalize {α : Type} [Storage α] {heads rows columns : Nat}
    (orthogonalizer : Orthogonalizer α [rows, columns])
    (momentum : MatrixTensor α rows (heads * columns)) :
    MatrixTensor α rows (heads * columns) :=
  merge fun head => orthogonalizer.apply (split momentum head)

/-- Splitting a Per-Head Muon direction recovers the independently orthogonalized head blocks. -/
theorem split_orthogonalize {α : Type} [Storage α] {heads rows columns : Nat}
    (orthogonalizer : Orthogonalizer α [rows, columns])
    (momentum : MatrixTensor α rows (heads * columns)) :
    split (orthogonalize orthogonalizer momentum) =
      fun head => orthogonalizer.apply (split momentum head) := by
  exact split_merge _

/-- With an exact orthogonalizer, every head block of the reassembled update has orthonormal
columns. -/
theorem orthogonalize_hasExactColumnGram {α : Type} [Storage α] [Context α]
    {heads rows columns : Nat}
    (orthogonalizer : Orthogonalizer α [rows, columns])
    (hExact : ExactMatrixOrthogonalizer orthogonalizer)
    (momentum : MatrixTensor α rows (heads * columns)) :
    ∀ head, HasExactColumnGram (split (orthogonalize orthogonalizer momentum) head) := by
  intro head
  rw [split_orthogonalize]
  exact hExact (split momentum head)

/-- An approximate orthogonalizer's Gram-residual bound carries over to every reassembled head. -/
theorem orthogonalize_hasApproxColumnGram {α : Type} [Storage α] [Context α]
    {heads rows columns : Nat} (epsilon : α)
    (orthogonalizer : Orthogonalizer α [rows, columns])
    (hApprox : ApproxMatrixOrthogonalizer epsilon orthogonalizer)
    (momentum : MatrixTensor α rows (heads * columns)) :
    ∀ head, HasApproxColumnGram epsilon
      (split (orthogonalize orthogonalizer momentum) head) := by
  intro head
  rw [split_orthogonalize]
  exact hApprox (split momentum head)

end PerHeadMuon

end KimiK3

module

public import NN.Spec.Layers.Loss

/-!
# Masked next-token pretraining

Average the next-token loss over a nonempty set of supervised positions. Text targets can be
selected even when the input includes visual embeddings or padding. This file also states a
logit-gradient formula and proves its values on supervised and masked rows.

Reference: Kimi K3 technical report, Section 2.5 and Sections 3--4, pp. 10--14.
https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.24653.
-/

@[expose] public section

namespace KimiK3

open Spec TorchLean
open Tensor
open scoped BigOperators

namespace Pretraining

/-- Negative log-likelihood of one target token, evaluated from unnormalized vocabulary logits. -/
noncomputable def tokenLoss {vocabSize : Nat}
    (logits : Tensor ℝ [vocabSize]) (target : Fin vocabSize) : ℝ :=
  -Tensor.getScalar (Activation.logSoftmaxVecSpec logits) target

/-- Mean next-token loss over the positions selected by `supervised`.

The model may receive both text and visual embeddings, but its targets are vocabulary tokens.
Visual input positions, padding, and input-only protocol tokens are left out of `supervised`, so
their entries in `targets` never reach the loss.
-/
noncomputable def nextTokenLoss {sequenceLength vocabSize : Nat}
    (logits : Tensor ℝ [sequenceLength, vocabSize])
    (targets : Fin sequenceLength → Fin vocabSize)
    (supervised : Finset (Fin sequenceLength)) (_hSupervised : supervised.Nonempty) : ℝ :=
  (∑ position ∈ supervised, tokenLoss (Spec.get logits position) (targets position)) /
    supervised.card

/-- Closed-form logit-gradient formula for the masked next-token objective.

Rows omitted from `supervised` have zero gradient. A supervised row uses the standard
`softmax(logits) - oneHot(target)` derivative, divided by the number of supervised positions.

No theorem here proves that this is the derivative or VJP of `nextTokenLoss`.
-/
noncomputable def logitGradientFormula {sequenceLength vocabSize : Nat}
    (logits : Tensor ℝ [sequenceLength, vocabSize])
    (targets : Fin sequenceLength → Fin vocabSize)
    (supervised : Finset (Fin sequenceLength)) (_hSupervised : supervised.Nonempty) :
    Tensor ℝ [sequenceLength, vocabSize] :=
  Tensor.stackLeading fun position =>
    if position ∈ supervised then
      scaleSpec
        (crossEntropyLogitsDerivSpec 0 (Spec.get logits position)
          (TorchLean.Tensor.oneHot vocabSize (targets position)))
        (1 / supervised.card)
    else
      Tensor.zeros [vocabSize]

/-- On every supervised position, the formula uses TorchLean's stable
cross-entropy-on-logits derivative, with the outer mean reduction applied. -/
theorem logitGradientFormula_at_supervised {sequenceLength vocabSize : Nat}
    (logits : Tensor ℝ [sequenceLength, vocabSize])
    (targets : Fin sequenceLength → Fin vocabSize)
    (supervised : Finset (Fin sequenceLength)) (hSupervised : supervised.Nonempty)
    (position : Fin sequenceLength) (hPosition : position ∈ supervised) :
    Spec.get (logitGradientFormula logits targets supervised hSupervised) position =
      scaleSpec
        (crossEntropyLogitsDerivSpec 0 (Spec.get logits position)
          (TorchLean.Tensor.oneHot vocabSize (targets position)))
        (1 / supervised.card) := by
  simp only [logitGradientFormula, Tensor.stackLeading, Spec.get_dim]
  rw [ite_eq_left hPosition]

/-- At every masked position the formula is zero. -/
theorem logitGradientFormula_at_masked {sequenceLength vocabSize : Nat}
    (logits : Tensor ℝ [sequenceLength, vocabSize])
    (targets : Fin sequenceLength → Fin vocabSize)
    (supervised : Finset (Fin sequenceLength)) (hSupervised : supervised.Nonempty)
    (position : Fin sequenceLength) (hPosition : position ∉ supervised) :
    Spec.get (logitGradientFormula logits targets supervised hSupervised) position =
      Tensor.zeros [vocabSize] := by
  simp only [logitGradientFormula, Tensor.stackLeading, Spec.get_dim]
  rw [ite_eq_right hPosition]

end Pretraining

namespace LanguageModel

/-- Evaluate the masked next-token objective on the logits of the complete language backbone, so
the pretraining loss belongs to a concrete model. -/
noncomputable def pretrainingLoss {cfg : TextConfig} {decayRank sequenceLength : Nat}
    (model : LanguageModel ℝ cfg decayRank)
    (embeddings : Tensor ℝ [sequenceLength, cfg.hiddenDim])
    (targets : Fin sequenceLength → Fin cfg.vocabSize)
    (supervised : Finset (Fin sequenceLength)) (hSupervised : supervised.Nonempty) : ℝ :=
  Pretraining.nextTokenLoss (model.logits embeddings) targets supervised hSupervised

end LanguageModel

end KimiK3
